title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS [SAP SUCCESS FACTORS]
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.


Buscamos profissional para atuar na gestão funcional e governança do ecossistema SAP de RH, com foco em SAP SuccessFactors (lado cliente, sem acesso a provisioning), SAP HCM migrando para SAP S/4, garantindo sustentação, evolução e alinhamento estratégico das soluções.


Responsabilidades e Requisitos Técnicos:

1. Gestão Funcional do SuccessFactors


  • Atuar como ponto focal interno da TI da solução SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Administrar configurações funcionais permitidas no ambiente produtivo (sem acesso a provisioning – essa responsabilidade é da consultoria AMS).
  • Organizar e priorizar demandas evolutivas junto ao RH.
  • Especificar requisitos com foco em melhorias ou novas demandas para atendimento via consultoria externa.
  • Escrever especificações funcionais para desenvolvimentos específicos ou integrações.
  • Validar entregas e realizar testes funcionais (UAT).
  • Conhecer, monitorar e direcionar ações nas integrações com sistemas satélites.
  • Entender processo de negócio e solução técnica para direcionar ações evolutivas nos APPs Fiori desenvolvidos em SAP BTP de modo a gerenciar as entregas, melhorias e suporte dado pela consultoria responsável.
  • Diferencial ter conhecimento na navegação do BTP e IAS.
  • Diferencial ter conhecimento em SFSF EC.
  • Acompanhar roadmap, tendências e atualizações SAP.
  • Analisar release notes, atualizações de quarters, avaliar impactos no ambiente, abrir e acompanhar chamados no SAP for Me.
  • Entender e suportar as liberações de Acessos conforme papéis e responsabilidades da governança GP.
  • Módulos SFSF atualmente instalados: EP, LMS, Recruiting, Metas e Desempenho, Carreira e Sucessão.

2. Gestão de Sistemas Satélites


  • Melhorias, sustentação e governança com foco em:
  • Conhecimentos em SAP HCM em PA, OM, PY, BN, TM e eSocial.
  • Apoiar no SAP HCM (suporte Rimini)
  • Participar ativamente no projeto de migração do ECC para S/4Hana (em andamento).
  • Diferencial com conhecimentos no Ronda (controle de ponto), DMS (gestão documental).
  • Monitorar e direcionar de atendimento ao suporte de interfaces e integrações aos sistemas que compõe o landscape de soluções de RH
  • Atuar em chamados específicos e/ou em incidentes críticos.
  • Apoiar e suportar à obrigações legais dentro dos processos de RH, tais como: eSocial, admissões, afastamentos, atualização sindicais, desligamento, movimentações, LGPD, etc.
  • Apoiar demais sistemas integrados ao ecosistema de RH como: SOC, eBox, AD Azure, etc.

3. Gestão de Demandas e Melhoria Contínua


  • Receber, organizar e classificar demandas do negócio.
  • Conduzir análise de impacto funcional e sistêmico.
  • Priorizar backlog em conjunto com stakeholders.
  • Elaborar cronogramas e plano de ação.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento técnico-funcional.
  • Garantir documentação de processos e soluções.
  • Quando em projetos, garantir transição adequada para sustentação.

4. Análise Técnica, Estratégica e Gestão de Fornecedores, Consultorias e Governo


  • Entender e analisar requisitos e/ou necessidades do RH.
  • Atuar como interface com consultoria de suporte SuccessFactors.
  • Atuar como interface com consultoria de suporte Rimini Street para SAP HCM ECC e SAP Notes para SAP S/4Hana.
  • Abrir e acompanhar chamados junto à SAP e à Rimini Street.
  • Avaliar propostas técnicas e estimativas.
  • Acompanhar SLAs contratuais.
  • Validar entregas técnicas e funcionais.
  • Acompanhar comunicados oficiais do Governo e ações juntos aos fornecedores.
  • Avaliar impactos e cumprir prazos regulatórios e legais junto à área de negócio.
  • Antecipar riscos sistêmicos e/ou regulatórios.
  • Propor melhorias estruturais.


CLT - SEG A SEX - HORÁRIO COMERCIAL

title: Junior .NET Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We seek a proficient Junior .NET Developer capable of maintaining high standards of technical quality and innovation, dedicated to continuous improvement, and committed to assisting clients worldwide. Success in this role requires detailed knowledge of development techniques, excellent communication, and organizational skills.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect and develop various services and APIs

- Apply SOLID principles to craft maintainable and high-quality code

- Collaborate with product owners to ensure features/changes align with business requirements and degreed strategy

- Engage closely with designers, UX, and other developers to grasp new features, dependencies, and technical intricacies

- Fulfill other assigned duties


Requirements:


- Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)

- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL Databases

- Experience with Microservices and the Cloud

- Knowledge of algorithms

- Understanding of IT infrastructure

- Proficiency in managing Agile methodologies

- Familiarity with best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions

- Understanding of Design Patterns

- Experience in developing entire applications from scratch

- Proficiency in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines

- Experience with version control

- Strong skills in unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Customer Success Pleno/Sênior
description:
Sobre a Growper


A Growper é a maior agência de performance para escritórios revisionais do Brasil. Somos especialistas em marketing jurídico com foco exclusivo em juros abusivos de veículos e imóveis, um nicho que exige linguagem precisa, conhecimento do público e uma operação de dados afiada.


Hoje gerenciamos mais de R$ 40 milhões em investimento mensal, atendemos 140+ clientes e geramos mais de 150 mil leads qualificados por mês. Saiba mais:


Estamos em um momento de crescimento e expansão. Buscamos pessoas com mentalidade de dono, foco em resultados e alto nível de responsabilidade para construir a próxima fase da empresa.


Sobre a vaga


Estamos buscando um CS Pleno para assumir com autonomia uma carteira de clientes estratégicos. Você não apenas acompanha campanhas, você conecta performance de mídia com os objetivos de negócio dos clientes, antecipa riscos e constrói relacionamentos que geram retenção e expansão de receita.


Responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar ativamente uma carteira de clientes com foco em retenção, crescimento e NPS saudável
  • Analisar campanhas de Facebook Ads em profundidade, identificando oportunidades de otimização e impacto no ROI
  • Acompanhar e interpretar indicadores-chave: churn rate, LTV, CAC, ticket médio, ROAS e CPL
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios de performance com narrativa estratégica e insights acionáveis
  • Conduzir reuniões de acompanhamento e QBRs com clientes de médio e alto porte
  • Identificar riscos de churn e acionar estratégias preventivas de forma proativa
  • Colaborar com mídia, criação e estratégia para maximizar entregas e resultados
  • Contribuir com melhorias nos processos internos de CS baseadas em dados e experiência


O que esperamos de você


  • 3+ anos em Customer Success, Account Management ou áreas correlatas em agências digitais ou startups
  • Domínio de Meta Ads e métricas de performance: CPA, ROAS, CPL, CAC, LTV
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e construir narrativas claras de resultado
  • Comunicação consultiva — saber ouvir, diagnosticar e apresentar soluções com confiança
  • Autonomia para gerenciar múltiplos clientes sem supervisão constante
  • Mentalidade de dono: responsabilidade total pela experiência e resultado da carteira
  • Experiência com apresentação de resultados e gestão de expectativas de clientes


O que oferecemos


  • 100% remoto 
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva de mercado
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar melhorias nos processos de CS
  • Ambiente data-driven com ferramentas e cultura de performance
  • Trilha para Sênior em curto/médio prazo


Por que a Growper?


  • Anywhere office: trabalhe de onde quiser, sem abrir mão de resultado
  • Meritocracia real: sem política, sem fila de espera. Crescimento é função de entrega.
  • Formação técnica de verdade: acesso às melhores plataformas internacionais de growth, analytics e mídia paga
  • Cultura de autonomia, dinamismo, disciplina e cooperação

title: Lead Data Engineering (Remoto)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa do setor de georastreamento na busca por um(a) Data Engineering Team Lead para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de dados e impulsionar a evolução da sua plataforma. Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil player-coach , capaz de equilibrar uma atuação técnica hands-on com a liderança de equipe, sendo responsável por guiar o time na construção de uma infraestrutura de dados moderna, escalável e orientada ao negócio. É essencial possuir inglês avançado ou fluente para conversação , já que a posição envolve interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais. A contratação é no modelo CLT , com atuação 100% remota .


Principais Responsabilidades:


Atuação Estratégica e Técnica

  • Atuar como engenheiro(a) sênior, participando diretamente do desenvolvimento (design, codificação e entrega de features).
  • Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure).
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio.
  • Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis.
  • Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma.
  • Liderar iniciativas de análise, planejamento e execução de projetos de dados.
  • Garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos.


Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (Airbyte, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory).
  • Construir e manter infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights).
  • Garantir governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Atuar na operação de ambientes produtivos, incluindo suporte a incidentes críticos.
  • Promover inovação contínua e adoção de novas tecnologias, incluindo uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos.
  • Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory.
  • Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala).
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP.
  • Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto.
  • Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse.
  • Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade.
  • Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.


Formação e Experiência

  • Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on).
  • Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

title: [Tech] Engenharia de Software Backend Pleno - Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, colaborando para manter um ambiente saudável e produtivo entre os membros da equipe;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir os produtos com foco em qualidade, utilizando testes automatizados e realizando revisões de código entre pares (code review);
  • Corrigir eventuais problemas nos sistemas com base na priorização definida pelo Product Owner, assegurando a satisfação dos clientes e usuários;
  • Realizar deploy em ambiente de produção utilizando processos de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD), garantindo a estabilidade da aplicação;
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;
  • Garantir a segurança e a qualidade das entregas, respeitando os padrões estabelecidos pela equipe;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas parceiras (DevOps, QA, Produto) na busca por soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Programação orientada a objetos (POO);
  • Linguagem Java (preferencialmente versão 8 ou superior);
  • Spring Framework (Core, Boot, Data, etc.);
  • Criação de APIs RESTful;
  • Controle de versionamento com Git;
  • Arquitetura baseada em microsserviços.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência com mensagerias (Kafka, RabbitMQ);
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD, BDD);
  • Criação de testes de integração e de carga;
  • Utilização de containers (Docker);
  • Orquestração com Kubernetes;
  • Banco de dados NoSQL (MongoDB);
  • Uso de cache (Redis);
  • Vivência com atuação em times ágeis e em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

title: [Tech] Engenharia de Software Backend Pleno - Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, colaborando para manter um ambiente saudável e produtivo entre os membros da equipe;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir os produtos com foco em qualidade, utilizando testes automatizados e realizando revisões de código entre pares (code review);
  • Corrigir eventuais problemas nos sistemas com base na priorização definida pelo Product Owner, assegurando a satisfação dos clientes e usuários;
  • Realizar deploy em ambiente de produção utilizando processos de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD), garantindo a estabilidade da aplicação;
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;
  • Garantir a segurança e a qualidade das entregas, respeitando os padrões estabelecidos pela equipe;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas parceiras (DevOps, QA, Produto) na busca por soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Programação orientada a objetos (POO);
  • Linguagem Java (preferencialmente versão 8 ou superior);
  • Spring Framework (Core, Boot, Data, etc.);
  • Criação de APIs RESTful;
  • Controle de versionamento com Git;
  • Arquitetura baseada em microsserviços.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência com mensagerias (Kafka, RabbitMQ);
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD, BDD);
  • Criação de testes de integração e de carga;
  • Utilização de containers (Docker);
  • Orquestração com Kubernetes;
  • Banco de dados NoSQL (MongoDB);
  • Uso de cache (Redis);
  • Vivência com atuação em times ágeis e em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

description:
Quem somos nós:

A Skintec é uma empresa referência em tecnologias para medicina estética e bem-estar, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no mercado . Atuamos ao lado de médicos e clínicas que buscam inovação, segurança e resultados consistentes, oferecendo soluções tecnológicas de alto padrão, respaldadas por evidências científicas e certificações internacionais.

Mais do que tecnologia, entregamos suporte especializado, relacionamento de longo prazo e desenvolvimento para nossos parceiros . Nosso time é movido pela Cultura WOW , que valoriza pessoas, excelência e a superação de expectativas.

Skintec — conectando tecnologia, pessoas e excelência médica.

Realizar venda consultiva, desenvolvendo negócios e gestão de contas, prospectar e realizar a

gestão de carteira de clientes da Skintec, foco em Medical e clientes chave de cada região.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em mercado de luxo e clientes de alto padrão;
  • Vivência anterior com Medical Devices ou corretatos;
  • Forte atuação em negociações de alto ticket e vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidades com CRM.



Condições:

Contratação PJ, estamos trabalhando com pretensões salarias e condições compatíveis do mercado.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Hands‑on AWS operations (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch).
  • Azure operations experience (VMs, VNet, NSG, AKS, Entra ID, Firewall, LB).
  • Strong troubleshooting & incident management (cloud, on‑prem, Linux/Windows).
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep/ARM, CDK).
  • Scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash).


And much better if you stand out for:

  • Familiarity with containerization technologies beyond basics (Docker + Kubernetes in production).
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (routing, load balancing, security).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows focused on reliability, patching, backup & DR.
  • Ability to create and maintain operational runbooks and documentation.
  • Prior participation in on-call rotations and leading post‑incident reviews.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and support AWS (primary) and Azure (secondary) cloud environments.
  • Handle tickets, incidents, troubleshooting, and root‑cause analysis.
  • Maintain core AWS and Azure services, including compute, networking, security, and Kubernetes.
  • Monitor performance, capacity, cost, and proactively resolve risks.
  • Execute changes through change management with minimal disruption.
  • Support hybrid cloud connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, DNS).
  • Participate in on‑call rotation and lead post‑incident reviews.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks, and automate tasks with scripting.
  • Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps workflows for stability, patching, backup, and DR.


Key Words:

  • AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch)

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Marketing Track)
description:
Work Remotely, Part-time, Internship


We want “Campus Connectors”—social, trend-aware, creative students who can link us with campus creators, produce viral content, and run fun events to make our brand pop on campus.


What You’ll Do:

● Get to know Your Peers: Track the real needs and content preferences of students from different backgrounds (like international students) continuously.

● Create Engaging Content Together: Participate in planning and producing social media content, and discover and collaborate with rising campus stars.

● Plan and Launch Fun Events: Help organize and support promotional events or collaborations that elevate brand activity and impact on campus.



We Hope You Are:

● A campus socializer: You're active in clubs and events, with a lot of friends online and offline, making you a key influencer.

● Trendy Visual Content Creator: You love snapping photos, editing videos, and are passionate about visual trends in fashion, beauty, and more.

● Operations Savvy: You have knowledge of managing social media and engaging with student behaviors and cultural trends.



Bonus Points If You Have:

● Relevant studies in fields like media, fashion, marketing, or sociology.

● Have content creation experience: run your own social account or create content regularly.

● Understand youth culture in regions like Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, Europe, or the US.

● Leadership experience in clubs or project organization on campus.



What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design


Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu VIP membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Data Scientist - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
We’re building a talent pool for Senior Data Scientist Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong SQL and Python experience . This position plays a key role in supporting product decision-making through data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence.


What You’ll Do

  • Help clear existing backlog and enhance the team’s data infrastructure and analytics capabilities.
  • Work with ETL processes, analytics, and BI tools to drive actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain data pipelines and workflows using Airflow.
  • Perform data cleaning, transformation, and combination of existing data tables in Snowflake.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to deliver accurate reporting and analytics.
  • Contribute to Streamlit dashboards and analytical tools.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience with Python and SQL in a data-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with data tools such as Airflow, Snowflake, and Streamlit.
  • Strong understanding of analytics best practices and product data workflows.
  • Basic knowledge or interest in cryptocurrencies, blockchain technology, and ERC-20 tokens.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones with overlap to US hours (preferably Eastern Time).


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in fintech, payments, or digital assets.
  • Understanding of blockchain data structures or related crypto analytics.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: OIC Engineer
description:
Job Title: OIC Engineer

Location: Remote - Brazil

Duration: 12+ Months


Skills:

  • OIC VBCS platform expertise
  • Java – Expert level
  • JavaScript – Expert Level

Job Description

  • Analyze systems integrations and creates systems and software architecture that keep enterprise data secure and compliant.

  • Build reusable code. Build efficiently upon the existing data model and quickly change gears as priorities change.

  • Follow, enhance, and contribute to group coding standards and best practices around documentation, code.
  • formatting, source-control.
  • Ability to assist business users to get familiarity with OIC (error log checking, OIC dashboards, examining payloads for errors, etc).

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Desenvolver e manter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);

● Elaborar e gerenciar artefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;

● Apoiar squads na modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência


Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)


Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers


Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)


Metodologias e Governança Técnica

● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna

● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados

● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io


Mentalidade e Comportamentos

● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas

● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc

● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto

● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica

● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos)

● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua


DIFERENCIAL:

● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: SAP SD Consultant
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled SAP SD Consultant with strong expertise in SAP ECC environments, business process analysis, and cross‑functional collaboration. The ideal candidate must be bilingual in English, possess hands‑on experience across the full lifecycle of SAP implementations, and be capable of supporting and optimizing Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) processes in a dynamic, global environment.


Key Responsibilities

SAP Functional Expertise

  • Participate in at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation (preferably in a business-facing role).
  • Configure, maintain, and enhance SAP SD and related peer applications.
  • Identify functional gaps and collaborate with technical teams to create and review functional specifications.
  • Support Product Supply requirements ensuring proper SAP configuration, development, and interface alignment (EDI, SAP PO, 3PL, etc.).
  • Work closely with business groups and developers to support, design, and enhance critical applications within SAP ECC 6.0 and integrated systems.

Business Process & System Analysis

  • Conduct business process analysis, documentation, and presentation.
  • Translate end-user requirements into detailed functional specifications.
  • Re-engineer business processes when necessary to drive efficiency.
  • Document process flows, requirements, design specifications, testing plans, and quality assurance outputs.
  • Coordinate and assist with system conversions and data migration activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) with the India SAP support team.
  • Collaborate with local and international teams across Order Management, Physical Distribution, and other functional areas.
  • Assist key users in managing Work Requests (developments, enhancements, production support) including:
  • Initial assessment
  • Determining need for internal/external assistance
  • Following standard procedures for cross-team collaboration

Systems Support & Testing

  • Troubleshoot and resolve transactional issues with internal users, customers, and EDI vendors.
  • Lead and participate in integrated system testing ensuring business requirements are met.
  • Conduct and coordinate user training, documentation, and validation activities.
  • Ensure high-quality procedures, processes, and guidelines across deliverables.

Project & Work Management

  • Manage project-related tasks, work request planning, and scheduling.
  • Assist reporting managers with work prioritization and status updates in the Work Request Database.
  • Support development, enhancement, and production support efforts across business-critical SAP functions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bilingual English – mandatory.
  • Proven experience in SAP SD with strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes.
  • Experience with SAP ECC 6.0, EDI integrations, SAP Process Orchestration, and related interfaces.
  • Solid background in system analysis, configuration, and functional specification development.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels.
  • Experience working in self-directed environments and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex system issues and guide users through process and system changes.
  • Strong documentation skills (requirements, specs, testing, QA).

Working Time

  • Must be available to work aligned with Client EST hours , considering the BRT time zone .


What You Can Expect from Us

  • Professional development and continuous growth of your skills.
  • Opportunities to work on international assignments.
  • A collaborative, diverse, inclusive, and innovative environment that values teamwork.

TCS Brazil Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation Voucher
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare Assistance
  • TotalPass
  • TCS Cares – Toll‑free 24/7 hotline offering psychological, legal, social, and financial support
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunities
  • Discounts with universities and language schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – Referral program with hiring bonus
  • TCS Gems – Performance recognition program
  • Xcelerate – Career platform with free mentoring

We encourage anyone interested to build a career in TCS to participate in our recruitment & selection process.

title: SAP SD Consultant
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled SAP SD Consultant with strong expertise in SAP ECC environments, business process analysis, and cross‑functional collaboration. The ideal candidate must be bilingual in English, possess hands‑on experience across the full lifecycle of SAP implementations, and be capable of supporting and optimizing Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) processes in a dynamic, global environment.


Key Responsibilities

SAP Functional Expertise

  • Participate in at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation (preferably in a business-facing role).
  • Configure, maintain, and enhance SAP SD and related peer applications.
  • Identify functional gaps and collaborate with technical teams to create and review functional specifications.
  • Support Product Supply requirements ensuring proper SAP configuration, development, and interface alignment (EDI, SAP PO, 3PL, etc.).
  • Work closely with business groups and developers to support, design, and enhance critical applications within SAP ECC 6.0 and integrated systems.

Business Process & System Analysis

  • Conduct business process analysis, documentation, and presentation.
  • Translate end-user requirements into detailed functional specifications.
  • Re-engineer business processes when necessary to drive efficiency.
  • Document process flows, requirements, design specifications, testing plans, and quality assurance outputs.
  • Coordinate and assist with system conversions and data migration activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) with the India SAP support team.
  • Collaborate with local and international teams across Order Management, Physical Distribution, and other functional areas.
  • Assist key users in managing Work Requests (developments, enhancements, production support) including:
  • Initial assessment
  • Determining need for internal/external assistance
  • Following standard procedures for cross-team collaboration

Systems Support & Testing

  • Troubleshoot and resolve transactional issues with internal users, customers, and EDI vendors.
  • Lead and participate in integrated system testing ensuring business requirements are met.
  • Conduct and coordinate user training, documentation, and validation activities.
  • Ensure high-quality procedures, processes, and guidelines across deliverables.

Project & Work Management

  • Manage project-related tasks, work request planning, and scheduling.
  • Assist reporting managers with work prioritization and status updates in the Work Request Database.
  • Support development, enhancement, and production support efforts across business-critical SAP functions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bilingual English – mandatory.
  • Proven experience in SAP SD with strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes.
  • Experience with SAP ECC 6.0, EDI integrations, SAP Process Orchestration, and related interfaces.
  • Solid background in system analysis, configuration, and functional specification development.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels.
  • Experience working in self-directed environments and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex system issues and guide users through process and system changes.
  • Strong documentation skills (requirements, specs, testing, QA).

Working Time

  • Must be available to work aligned with Client EST hours , considering the BRT time zone .


What You Can Expect from Us

  • Professional development and continuous growth of your skills.
  • Opportunities to work on international assignments.
  • A collaborative, diverse, inclusive, and innovative environment that values teamwork.

TCS Brazil Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation Voucher
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare Assistance
  • TotalPass
  • TCS Cares – Toll‑free 24/7 hotline offering psychological, legal, social, and financial support
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunities
  • Discounts with universities and language schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – Referral program with hiring bonus
  • TCS Gems – Performance recognition program
  • Xcelerate – Career platform with free mentoring
  • Tata Consultancy Services is an equal opportunity employer, our commitment to diversity & inclusion drives our efforts to provide equal opportunity to all candidates who meet our required knowledge & competency needs, irrespective of any socio-economic background, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity/expression , age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation or any others. We encourage anyone interested to build a career in TCS to participate in our recruitment & selection process.
  • At Tata Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects each person. Our motto is Inclusion without exception.

title: Backend / Dados (SCALA)
description:
Você tem interesse em uma vaga de Engenheiro(a) de Dados, mas com pegada de backend: a maior parte do trabalho é Scala puro em jobs Flink/Kafka.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolvimento do backend de aplicações web; Implementar e realizar testes unitários no software desenvolvido para garantia da qualidade;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time para análise de requisitos, planejamento de sprints, revisão das sprints, dentre outros;
  • Seguir metodologias indicadas, regras do produto e cliente;
  • Realizar revisões de design, atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Atuar em equipe responsáveis por implementar sistemas big data.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, ou área relacionada;
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente (mandatório, para atender cliente internacional)
  • Experiência comprovada com programação em Scala;
  • Experiência comprovada com Apache Spark;
  • Experiência comprovada em construção e manutenção de sistemas Big Data de grande escala;
  • Experiência prática em projetos de engenharia de dados;
  • Desejável experiência com Kafka e Cassandra (ou ferramentas similares) Desejável experiência com Java;
  • Desejável experiência com Apache Flink.

title: Senior Front-end Developer (React.js) - Project
description:
We are looking for a remote, skilled Senior Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping ideas and user feedback into delightful experiences, developing and implementing user interface components into the latest React.js concepts and workflows, and leading the engineering efforts for user-facing features. You will work with our product and user experience teams to deliver end-to-end features that deliver business value that users love.


This project has a 6-month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform allows companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the User Experience and Product teams to create end-to-end designs for new features
  • Take ownership of product features from design, implementation, and delivery, to post-delivery feedback and follow-up work
  • Coordinate development efforts across team members and ensure successful delivery
  • Architect, develop, and implement highly-responsive user interface components using JavaScript and React.js
  • Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, and help find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience as a front-end engineer writing single-page applications that communicate with API back-ends, and knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A well-developed understanding of frontend concepts and various frameworks
  • A focus on delivering value to customers
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field
  • Node.js and Python experience
  • Additional Information
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays annually
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger


The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Coordenador de Ciência de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Principais atividades:

  • Coordenar as atividades operacionais da equipe de Data Science;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de Data Science alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais;
  • Participar ativamente nos processos de recrutamento, desenvolvimento de talentos e desligamento de profissionais;
  • Fomentar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, criando um ambiente propício para aprendizado contínuo e aprimoramento de habilidades;
  • Interagir de forma colaborativa com líderes de outras áreas para compreender suas necessidades analíticas;
  • Participar ativamente na gestão de orçamentos e recursos;
  • Relatar os resultados para a gerência e propor melhorias;
  • Tomar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao direcionamento de projetos de Data Science.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Necessário graduação completa;
  • Desejável Pós-graduação, mestrado ou doutorado desejável em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia ou área correlata.
  • Conhecimento avançado de técnicas de IA aplicada, incluindo IA Generativa, modelos preditivos e agents.
  • Necessário experiência em liderança, desenvolvimento de talentos e orçamento;
  • Necessário experiência em gestão de projetos de dados;
  • Necessário experiência em técnicas, linguagens e ferramentas de aprendizado de máquina e Data Science, como Python, R, frameworks de IA e Machine Learning, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, TensorFlow, XGBoost, LightGBM, Kubeflow, entre outros;
  • Necessário experiência em aplicação de métodos estatísticos e análise preditiva;
  • Necessário experiência em desenvolvimento de pipelines para análise e interpretação de dados, aplicação e produção de algoritmos de IA tradicional, IA generativa e Agentes de IA.
  • Desejável ter atuado utilizando ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Project);
  • Desejável experiência em Cloud providers;
  • Desejável experiência em práticas de governança de dados e conformidade com regulamentações de privacidade, como GDPR.
  • Desejável experiência em medidas de segurança de dados para proteger a integridade e a confidencialidade das informações.
  • Desejável domínio do Pacote Office e inglês intermediário..


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: 100%Home Office

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: 5x2

Horário de Trabalho: segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Especialista de Inovação
description:
Confira As Principais Atividades Desta Vaga

  • Liderar a frente de Inteligência Artificial, conectando demandas das áreas de negócio às soluções tecnológicas
  • Coordenar o setup e a evolução da esteira de IA em parceria com consultorias especializadas
  • Definir e garantir os requisitos de arquitetura dos aplicativos e soluções de IA
  • Conduzir o mapeamento, análise e priorização de casos de uso junto às áreas internas
  • Gerenciar a atuação de fornecedores e consultorias, assegurando entregas dentro dos padrões técnicos e estratégicos da companhia
  • Articular o suporte e a atuação do time interno de dados nas iniciativas de IA


Requisitos e qualificações

Curtiu?! Vamos em frente, entenda o que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino superior completo
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos técnicos de Inteligência Artificial
  • Visão sólida de arquitetura de soluções
  • Experiência em gestão de fornecedores e consultorias
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis

title: Analista de Devops Sr
description:
Com o que você irá atuar:


  • Administrar ambientes em nuvem (principalmente AWS), garantindo performance, disponibilidade e segurança
  • Automatizar processos com ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou AWS CDK
  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD integradas à infraestrutura
  • Monitorar recursos de cloud usando CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana ou similares
  • Gerenciar recursos como EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, ELB, Route53, entre outros
  • Suportar o time de desenvolvimento em deploys, testes e troubleshooting de infraestrutura
  • Apoiar na definição e implementação de políticas de segurança, backup e governança em cloud
  • Participar de projetos de migração, modernização e otimização de workloads para nuvem
  • Integrar práticas de segurança no ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software
  • Interagir com as equipes de desenvolvimento para implementar controles nas plataformas Dotnet, Node.js e Python.
  • Automatizar testes e integrar ferramentas no pipeline de CI/CD.
  • Gerenciar e monitorar a configuração das infraestruturas em nuvem e on-premise.



O que esperamos de você?


  • Experiência prática com serviços AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, etc.)
  • Vivência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em automação de ambientes e CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Noções de redes, segurança em cloud e boas práticas de arquitetura
  • Habilidade com sistemas Linux e scripts (bash, python, etc.)
  • Experiência com práticas em ambientes de desenvolvimento com Dotnet, Node.js e Python.
  • Experiência em configuração de servidores Web com IIS, Nginx e Apache.



O que oferecemos como benefícios:


  • VR
  • Vale transporte
  • Assistência médica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Day Off de Aniversário
  • Gympass

title: Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and distributed data systems
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows across multiple systems
  • Lead analytics modules and communicate technical outcomes clearly
  • Partner with consulting teams to define delivery outcomes and technical approach
  • Deliver production-ready solutions (from prototype to enterprise-grade systems)


Technical Requirements – Required

  • Python and SQL
  • Relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or similar)
  • NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j or similar)
  • Distributed systems (Spark / PySpark / Hadoop)
  • Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)


Nice to Have

  • Airflow, Data Factory, Glue, Prefect, Dagster
  • Snowflake / Star schema modeling
  • Kafka / streaming frameworks
  • Docker / Kubernetes
  • Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)

title: L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE


Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

• Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

• Experience: 7–10 years

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.


Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: OpenText Consultant
description:
OpenText VIM/OCR Expert - Remote working - English Speaking


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of OpenText VIM for automated vendor invoice processing.
  • Configure and support invoice capture, OCR extraction, validation, workflow routing, and posting to SAP FI/MM .
  • Implement and optimize OpenText Intelligent Capture Center (ICC) or equivalent OCR tools for invoice data extraction.
  • Configure VIM Document Processing (DP), exception handling, and workflow approvals .
  • Integrate VIM with SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable, PO invoice processing, and vendor master data .
  • Support ArchiveLink/Content Server integration for document storage and retrieval.
  • Assist with system testing, integration testing, and go-live readiness .
  • Troubleshoot issues related to OCR extraction, invoice matching, workflow processing, and FI posting errors .
  • Support go-live and hypercare activities, including improving touchless invoice processing rates.

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Analista de Redes Sênior (Cisco | Routing & Switching | Monitoramento)

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Java (versões 7 a 21)
  • Criar e evoluir APIs REST utilizando Spring Boot
  • Integrar sistemas por meio de mensageria (RabbitMQ)
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle e MySQL)

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
We are looking for a seasoned Full Stack or Frontend-focused developer with strong .NET and C# expertise to join a globally distributed team. The ideal candidate bridges legacy system maintenance with modern platform evolution, delivering robust, secure, and scalable solutions in an international insurance environment.


Mandatory Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience (full stack or frontend-focused);
  • Strong command of .NET / C# development;
  • Proven experience maintaining legacy .NET Framework applications alongside modernization work in .NET Core / .NET;
  • Proficiency with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3;
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs, including API integrations;
  • Hands-on experience with Kendo UI for component-rich frontend development;
  • Experience building cross-platform applications with .NET MAUI;
  • Working knowledge of relational databases (SQL Server preferred).
  • Security & Identity: OAuth 2.0, JWT, and other identity/authentication frameworks;
  • Architecture & Patterns: MVC, MVVM, layered architecture, microservices.


Language Requirements

  • Fluent in English — written and verbal
  • Fluent in Spanish — written and verbal


Nice to Have

  • Microsoft Power Platform : hands-on familiarity with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI;
  • Azure & DevOps: Azure services — web apps, API hosting, and DevOps pipelines and Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks experience;
  • Security & Compliance: Secure coding practices, identity management, and data protection (critical for the international insurance context);
  • Industry Experience: Background in healthcare or insurance industries is a strong plus.


Location : Home Office

PJ Contract - Salary: Negotiable

Start Availability : Immediate

title: Data Pipeline Engineer Sr / OT–IT Integration
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Data Pipeline Engineer Sr / OT–IT Integration .


In this role you will:

Design, build, and operate resilient OT-IT data pipelines across SCADA/MES and enterprise systems. Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), model/govern industrial data, and deliver secure batch and streaming integrations on prem and in the cloud.

  • End to end pipelines: Design, implement, and operate batch/streaming flows from SCADA, MES, and Historians to cloud/enterprise (Azure/AWS/GCP); Experience in Azure Event Hubs/Event Grid is plus.
  • UNS & modeling: Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), data modeling, and metadata management; ensure data quality, lineage, and governance.
  • Industrial integration: Connect (Ignition, HighByte, HiveMQ advantageous) using OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus; build/consume RESTful APIs and connectors for SCADA, MES, LIMS, Historians.
  • Design schemas and tune performance across SQL and NoSQL stores.
  • Security & reliability: implement authN/authZ best practices; Design for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Dev practices: use Git/GitHub (branching, reviews, releases) and create clear architecture diagrams, process flows, and specifications.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelors in engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing or life sciences with OT/IT interoperability; familiarity with GxP, regulated data flows, and enterprise data governance is a plus.
  • Strong analytical/problem solving with structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communication and stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Fluent English
