title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient:


We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies

Arquiteto de soluções Azure/.Net Core

Estamos buscando um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções em Nuvem com foco em aplicações nativas em nuvem no Azure e em aplicações de IA. Abrangendo design, construção/codificação e operações para remover obstáculos técnicos e desafios de adoção, liderando e orquestrando todos os recursos técnicos necessários para a evolução e a conclusão do projeto, com o melhor sucesso possível para o cliente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetura e desenvolvimento de IA com IA Copilot Studio e Microsoft Foundry;
  • Especialista em Arquitetura NET Framework/.NET Core usando a linguagem C# e Visual Studio.
  • Experiência técnica em escala corporativa com infraestruturas de nuvem e híbridas, designs de arquitetura, migrações e gestão de tecnologia com Cloud Azure.
  • Experiência com arquitetura escalável usando serviços de nuvem para aplicações, como serviços do Azure: App Service, API Management, tecnologias serverless, orquestração de contêineres (por exemplo, Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry etc.), frameworks de microsserviços, SDKs etc.
  • Práticas de desenvolvimento de software como DevOps e pipelines de ferramentas de CI/CD (por exemplo, Jenkins, Spinnaker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Visual Studio).
  • Arquitetura e troubleshooting do Internet Information Services (IIS).
  • Habilidades de apresentação técnica e com foco no cliente, com alto nível de conforto para falar com públicos grandes e pequenos.
  • Diagnóstico e resolução de problemas relacionados à implantação de aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes on-premises/nuvem.
  • Experiência e entendimento de grandes portfólios de aplicações em ambientes corporativos (incluindo migração de workloads on-premises para a nuvem).
  • Experiência técnica em escala corporativa com hospedagem de aplicações nativas em nuvem, abrangendo design de software, desenvolvimento, implantação e refatoração/migrações de aplicações.
  • Adapta metodologias e aplica governança para identificar, comunicar e minimizar riscos de negócio e técnicos (por exemplo, Well-Architected Framework, Enterprise Scale Landing Zone, Cloud Adoption Framework). Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, documentar e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções tecnológicas, garantindo alinhamento com as estratégias de negócio e padrões corporativos.

• Apoiar o desenho de soluções integradas, considerando escalabilidade, segurança, performance e interoperabilidade.

• Elaborar artefatos técnicos como diagramas de arquitetura, fluxos de integração e especificações de alto nível.

• Avaliar tecnologias, frameworks e ferramentas que suportem as necessidades de negócio e TI.

• Atuar como ponte entre times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e áreas de negócio.

• Participar de análises de viabilidade técnica e estimativas de esforço em novos projetos e demandas.

• Apoiar a governança de arquitetura, zelando pela padronização e aderência aos princípios da empresa.

• Contribuir para a evolução de arquiteturas legadas, promovendo modernização e transformação digital.

• Elaborar a arquitetura de soluções para novos projetos e evoluções de sistemas existentes.

• Criar e manter atualizados os artefatos técnicos relacionados à arquitetura (diagramas, especificações, modelos de integração).

• Apoiar as áreas de negócio e desenvolvimento na definição de soluções tecnológicas.

• Realizar avaliação técnica de propostas, tecnologias e ferramentas.

• Garantir a aderência aos padrões de segurança, qualidade, escalabilidade e governança de TI.

• Atuar na identificação e mitigação de riscos arquiteturais em projetos e soluções.

• Apoiar a disseminação de boas práticas de arquitetura entre os times de tecnologia.

• Contribuir com a evolução dos frameworks, padrões e diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa.


Requisitos técnicos:

• Certificação AZ-900 Microsoft Azure

• Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (MVC, SOA, Microserviços, Event-Driven, entre outros).

• Experiência com APIs, barramento de serviços (ESB), integrações e arquitetura orientada a serviços.

• Conhecimentos em segurança da informação aplicada à arquitetura.

• Domínio de ferramentas de modelagem como Enterprise Architect, Draw.io, ArchiMate, Lucidchart, entre outras.

• Capacidade de definir e aplicar princípios de arquitetura corporativa e governança de TI.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Buscamos um Desenvolvedor .NET & Angular com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento, testes e manutenção de aplicações Web, APIs e integrações, utilizando bancos de dados SQL/Oracle/Postgres como backend. O profissional atuará na criação de soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas às melhores práticas do mercado, contribuindo ativamente com análises, arquitetura e qualidade do código.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e integração de aplicações Web, APIs e componentes utilizando .NET, .NET Core, Angular, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS e bancos de dados relacionais.
  • Desenvolver Web Forms, aplicações MVC e APIs para apoiar funções de negócio.
  • Participar da análise de requisitos, propondo soluções técnicas e contribuindo com o design e a arquitetura de software.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, identificar problemas e sugerir padrões e melhorias baseadas em ocorrências recorrentes.
  • Fornecer orientação técnico-funcional, compreendendo o negócio, ecossistema e soluções já existentes.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes, revisão de código e documentação.
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento e entrega com o time de desenvolvimento e gestão.
  • Produzir documentação adequada em todas as etapas do SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
  • Sugerir soluções criativas e alternativas técnicas sempre que aplicável.
  • Trabalhar de forma independente, com mínima supervisão, entregando resultados consistentes.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de programação, conhecimento sólido em OOP e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • (Desejável) Conhecimento em Python para backend.

Qualificações Técnicas (Obrigatórias)

  • Sólida de experiência em desenvolvimento com .NET C#, Web Forms, MVC, Angular, JavaScript e jQuery.
  • Experiência prática em projetos Angular.
  • Forte expertise em .NET e .NET Core, com bom entendimento de Web API, REST e protocolos HTTP.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento como TFS, GitHub ou Git.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de logging como Microsoft Enterprise Library, log4Net, Azure Application Insights, entre outros.
  • Entendimento de provedores de nuvem e seus componentes para implementação de soluções.
  • Ótima compreensão de padrões de projeto, arquitetura e boas práticas para melhoria de performance.
  • Experiência com Angular/ReactJS (desejável) e Vue.js (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em DevOps/DevSecOps.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises complexas e pesquisas técnicas detalhadas quando necessário.

title: Physical Therapist
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Physical Therapist to join our team.


If you have a passion for improving lives through exercise, certifications in sports medicine or orthopedic expertise, we want to hear from you. Our ideal candidate has a minimum of 3 years of experience, along with additional certifications, and is proficient in advanced English.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunity for career advancement and professional growth.
  • Full-time position with the flexibility to work from a home office.
  • Engaging work environment with deep human interaction, focused on patient care.
  • Chance to make a significant impact on patients' health and well-being.


Salary:

  • After a paid initial 4 month intensive education and on-boarding process which is paid at 1st month 1st month: R$3,100, 2nd month: R$4,650, 3rd month: R$6,200, 4th month: R$7,750. After one year, there will be an opportunity to increase your income beyond R$7,750, with most team members eventually earning over R$9,300 per month.
  • After your first year with us you will have additional benefits of 2 weeks paid vacation, health insurance, and retirement funds.


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency for clear communication.
  • Ability to effectively convey exercise techniques.
  • Sports medicine or Orthopedic expertise to address specific needs and limitations.
  • Additional certifications showcasing your commitment to professional growth.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Outgoing personality to motivate and engage patients.
  • Continuous training mindset to stay updated with industry advancements.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage patient progress and programs.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and provide feedback on personalized exercise programs for patients.
  • Utilize your teaching background to educate and empower patients.
  • Leverage orthopedic expertise to design safe and effective exercise routines.
  • Provide ongoing guidance and support for patients' fitness journeys.
  • Maintain open and effective communication with patients.


Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where continuous training and deep human interaction are valued.


Employment Type

Full-time

description:
Project Description:

We are seeking a skilled and hands-on Data Engineer with proven experience in Databricks, Apache Kafka, and real-time data streaming solutions.


Responsibilities:

- Design and implement scalable data pipelines using Databricks and Kafka

- Build and maintain real-time streaming solutions for high-volume data

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data flows into broader systems

- Optimize performance and reliability of data processing workflows

- Ensure data quality, lineage, and compliance across streaming and batch pipelines

- Participate in agile development processes and contribute to technical documentation


Mandatory Skills Description:

5+ years of experience in data engineering roles

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

- 4+ years of experience with Databricks data pipelines

- Strong hands-on experience with PySpark and/or Apache Spark.

- Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.

- Knowledge of FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) standards and experience with healthcare data integration projects.

- Proficiency with CI/CD, GitHub (pull requests, branching, code reviews).

- Experience writing unit tests and performing data validation

- Experience supporting production systems and deployments

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

title: Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão — Curadoria, Otimização e Escala (WhatsApp e IA)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão será responsável por evoluir a jornada conversacional da empresa no WhatsApp, nosso principal canal de aquisição e conversão. Essa pessoa atuará na otimização contínua da experiência, reduzindo atritos, recuperando leads e aumentando a eficiência do funil por meio de automação, testes e uso de IA.



Responsabilidades

  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar a jornada conversacional de ponta a ponta no WhatsApp, identificando gargalos, fricções e oportunidades de melhoria nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Evoluir a arquitetura dos fluxos conversacionais com foco em experiência, engajamento, recuperação e conversão.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups, segmentações e estrutura de fluxo.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios, campanhas de reengajamento e estratégias de recuperação.
  • Trabalhar na personalização da jornada a partir de clusters de audiência, comportamento e contexto do cliente.
  • Apoiar a construção de dashboards e análises da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados, garantindo visibilidade dos principais indicadores de performance.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com Marketing, Vendas, BI, Operações e Produto/Tech para transformar insights em melhorias concretas na experiência e nos resultados.
  • Contribuir com o uso de IA e automação para escalar conversas com mais eficiência, relevância e capacidade de conversão.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Growth, CRO, Lifecycle, CRM, Produto ou áreas correlatas, com foco em conversão e evolução de jornada.
  • Vivência prática com canais conversacionais, especialmente WhatsApp, automação de mensagens e/ou chatbots.
  • Capacidade de mapear funis, identificar gargalos e transformar análise em ação.
  • Repertório em testes A/B, experimentação e otimização contínua de jornada.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada para acompanhar métricas de funil, cohort, LTV, CAC e performance por etapa.
  • Boa visão de experiência do cliente e comportamento em jornadas digitais.
  • Capacidade técnica para utilizar ou estruturar soluções com IA, agentes e automações aplicadas à conversão.
  • Boa comunicação e influência para atuar com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, crédito, cobrança, serviços financeiros ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Vivência com desenho de experiências conversacionais e arquitetura de fluxos.
  • Experiência em produto, CX ou gestão de jornadas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Supabase, Metabase, Power BI ou ferramentas similares.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização, qualificação e conversão em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.
  • Experiência com plataformas conversacionais como Blip, ColmeIA ou similares.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Senior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Develop data integration services that accelerate customer onboarding processes.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Devops Java + AWS (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Java e que possui conhecimentos em AWS.
  • Experiência com CI/CD, (Kubernetes / Jenkins / Docker) será um diferencial.
  • Experiência com banco de dados;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas correlatas.

Buscamos alguém com perfil proativo, analítico e orientado à automação, que contribua ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da infraestrutura


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: Paid PPC Performance Marketing Manager
description:
We are first and foremost a great team full of ambitious and proactive individuals whose goal is to

become the best professionals they can be and make Digital Silk a globally renowned digital agency.


We are seeking an expert level Paid PPC Performance Marketing Manager with proven hands-on expertise in:

  • Be hands-on in setting up paid marketing campaigns & strategies to generate results for a large portfolio of clients.
  • Lead advanced account builds and restructures (naming conventions, campaign architecture, match type strategy, query mining, audience layering, exclusions, asset strategy, Conversions API’s, ETL’s etc.).
  • Oversee & train marketing team members on building and optimizing campaigns
  • Creating effective marketing copy to generate engagement
  • Know how to responsibly and effectively use AI to streamline deliverables, create reports and enhance results.


Digital Silk is built upon the principles of self-betterment, excellence, proactivity, and teamwork. If you share our passion and values, and want to be challenged and thrive in your career, then you’ll fit right in.


Digital Silk offers yearly growth opportunities AND company shares for all team members.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position as our headquarters are in the US. We do require team members to work 8am to 5pm EST (with breaks) as our clients are in the US.


Requirements & Responsibilities:

● Minimum 7 years of digital marketing experience

● Proven hands-on expertise in PPC/paid search (Google Ads is essential; Microsoft Ads strongly preferred).

● Lead and mentor a team of paid media specialists/managers - improve performance through coaching, audits, training, and SOPs.

● Ensure clean, reliable measurements: conversion setup and QA, GA4 alignment, GTM, UTM governance, and performance diagnostics.

● Experience in at least 2 additional programmatic channels (e.g., Paid Social, YouTube, Display/Programmatic, Shopping/Feeds, etc.).

● Establish high standards for quality, speed, documentation, and accountability.

● Help build scalable processes that improve client outcomes and internal efficiency. Translate business goals into measurable media plans, including channel mix, budget allocation, forecasting, and pacing.

● Drive continuous improvement through testing: ad copy/creative tests, landing page/CRO collaboration, audience experiments, bid strategy tests, and offer positioning.

● Proven expertise in creating effective marketing strategies and reports

● Proven ability to lead teams and improve marketing performance

● Effective time management skills. Ability to multitask and manage multiple teams and projects

● Strong marketing copywriting skills is CRITICAL

● Proven ability to manage teams and budgets

● Professional and proactive work ethic

● High competence in project and stakeholder management

● Excellent interpersonal, communication skills

● Able to work EST hours work 8am to 5pm EST (with breaks)


What we offer at Digital Silk:


● A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth

● Competitive pay, salary growth and bonuses

● Equity ownership in our company – share in profit upon company sale!

● Challenging projects and opportunity to work with great team members

● Work-from-home opportunity

● 4 weeks paid time off


We are a growing digital agency and are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Recruitment steps:


· Apply via LinkedIn

· Receive short questionnaire

· Send back answers + CV

· Have a short intro call with our Recruitment Team

· Get introduced to our Hiring Managers

· Get feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Consultor Funcional SAP, Testes, Negócios
description:
CHAMADA ÚNICA – BOOTCAMP SAP CCS|PROGRAMA DE CAPACITAÇÃO


Não perca a oportunidade de fazer parte de um Programa de Capacitação exclusivo para um processo de seleção do BOOTCAMP SAP CCS - Customer Care & Service.

Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:


O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.


O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.


Vantagens de participar:

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento


Informações importantes:


Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.


Idioma: não é requerido, mas se tiver aumentam suas chances de participação


Etapas do processo: Triagem|Teste de Raciocínio Lógico|Entrevistas RH e Técnicas


Localização: residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil, preferencialmente para a região de SP, RJ e BH.


Participação: Formação Custeada Integralmente


Se você atende aos requisitos mínimos, envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail:(Bootcamp SAP CCS)


Vagas limitadas! Não perca essa oportunidade única de transformar sua carreira!

Ative para ver a imagem maior.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)

Location: Remote – Brazil


Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript expertise to build scalable backend systems and data services. The ideal candidate will have recent hands-on experience with Node.js , strong database expertise in MongoDB and SQL , and experience building high-performance APIs .


This role focuses on designing and developing scalable backend services that support high-volume data processing and integration across digital platforms. Experience with GraphQL is preferred but not mandatory.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Build and optimize REST/GraphQL APIs for high-performance data access and integration.
  • Develop and maintain data models and database schemas across MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Implement scalable data ingestion and processing pipelines .
  • Work with distributed systems in a cloud-based environment .
  • Ensure performance optimization, reliability, and scalability of backend services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, architecture, and engineering.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Follow DevOps best practices , including CI/CD, testing, and monitoring.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering or data engineering .
  • Strong recent hands-on experience with Node.js .
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript .
  • Strong experience with MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Experience building REST APIs or GraphQL APIs .
  • Solid understanding of data modeling and database design .
  • Experience working in cloud environments (AWS preferred) .
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and modern development practices .


Nice to Have

  • Experience with GraphQL architecture or schema design .
  • Experience with distributed systems and high transaction platforms .
  • Knowledge of ETL pipelines and data processing frameworks .
  • Experience working in digital media, sports, or high-scale consumer platforms .


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field , or equivalent practical experience.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Responsabilidades:

Experiência em .NET e React

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança,

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.


Contratação CLT + Hibrido no Rio de janeiro 3 dias.

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

• English for writing and speaking

• Peru and Chile taxation would be a plus

• Spanish would be a plus

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Crypto Broker
description:
InvesTec UAE is a fast-growing, globally oriented investment and fintech company with strong roots in Indonesia and a rapidly expanding international footprint. We specialize in digital assets, crypto trading infrastructure, and institutional-grade brokerage solutions. Our mission is to bridge traditional finance with the evolving world of blockchain by delivering liquidity, transparency, and scalable trading services to clients worldwide.


As part of our expansion into Latin America, we are seeking a driven and client-focused Crypto Broker to support and grow our trading operations in Brazil. This is a fully remote role offering the opportunity to work closely with high-net-worth individuals, active traders, and institutional clients in one of the fastest-growing crypto markets globally.


Key Responsibilities
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with clients including HNWIs, professional traders, and institutional participants.
  • Execute crypto trades on behalf of clients, ensuring best execution, pricing, and liquidity.
  • Provide market insights, trading ideas, and ongoing support to clients to enhance trading activity.
  • Monitor crypto market conditions, price movements, and liquidity across major exchanges.
  • Coordinate with internal trading desks and liquidity providers to execute large or complex orders.
  • Maintain high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication and relationship management.
  • Ensure compliance with internal procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to grow trading volume and expand the client base in Brazil.


Requirements
  • Proven experience as a broker, trader, or sales professional in cryptocurrency, fintech, or financial markets.
  • Strong understanding of crypto markets, exchanges, order types, and trading strategies.
  • Experience handling client relationships and executing trades in a fast-paced environment.
  • Existing network of traders, investors, or crypto clients is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Fluent English; Portuguese is highly preferred.
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working remotely.


What We Offer
  • Competitive annual salary: USD 60,000 – 75,000
  • Performance-based bonuses tied to trading volume and client activity
  • Fully remote role with flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work with global clients and advanced trading infrastructure
  • Exposure to high-growth crypto markets and institutional trading environments
  • Dynamic, international team with strong expertise in digital assets


This is an excellent opportunity for a results-driven professional to build strong client relationships, drive trading activity, and grow within a rapidly expanding global crypto brokerage business.

title: Desenvolvedor de Agente IA - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, permitindo que nossos clientes foquem em seus principais negócios enquanto cuidamos de suas necessidades de TI.

Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:

Desenvolvedor(a) de Agentes de IA – Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares
  • Cartão flex (alimentação e refeição)
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas
  • Auxílio creche
  • Seguro de vida
  • Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês
  • Programa de indicações com premiação
  • Licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de 20 dias
  • Acesso às plataformas de aprendizado (NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy – +80 mil cursos)
  • GetVibes: programa de escuta ativa com foco em melhoria contínua


O que esperar desta posição:

Você atuará como referência técnica no desenvolvimento de soluções avançadas de Inteligência Artificial, sendo responsável por projetar, desenvolver e otimizar agentes inteligentes que serão o núcleo de um assistente digital no contexto de cartões.

A posição envolve a criação de fluxos complexos de interação, orquestração de Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) e integração com múltiplos sistemas, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das soluções.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento de soluções em Inteligência Artificial
  • Proficiência em Python
  • Experiência com frameworks de agentes como LangChain e/ou LangGraph
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em LLMs e NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural)
  • Experiência com:
  • Prompt engineering
  • Fine-tuning de modelos
  • Experiência com integração via APIs REST
  • Vivência com construção de arquiteturas escaláveis


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com bibliotecas como Hugging Face, TensorFlow ou PyTorch
  • Conhecimento em MLOps
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes
  • Vivência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure )
  • Experiência com padrões de integração como MCP
  • Atuação com assistentes conversacionais ou agentes autônomos


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.

Se tiver dúvidas sobre a vaga ou sobre a Getronics, fique à vontade para entrar em contato com nosso time de RH pelo e-mail: .

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora .NET - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .NET - Pleno, para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver aplicações Backend .NET

Manter e evoluir sistemas existentes , analisando e depurando códigos com ferramentas como IDEs e DevTools do navegador (F12).

Desenvolver e manter APIs REST com .NET Core e Entity Framework.

Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura de software , como DDD (Domain-Driven Design), injeção de dependência e testes unitários.

Trabalhar com mensageria , principalmente RabbitMQ, mas também com alternativas como SQS, SNS ou Kafka.

Projetar e manter sistemas distribuídos baseados em microserviços.

Monitorar e diagnosticar aplicações usando ferramentas de observabilidade (ex: DataDog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch).

Utilizar bancos de dados não relacionais , como MongoDB ou DynamoDB.

Participar de pipelines de CI/CD , garantindo entregas contínuas e seguras.

Trabalhar com tecnologias de containerização e orquestração , como Docker e Kubernetes.

Utilizar serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure, etc.) , incluindo funções serverless e mensageria.

Colaborar em projetos via Azure DevOps , utilizando boards, pipelines e repositórios.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiencia com .NET
  • EntityFramework
  • Injeção de Dependencia
  • DDD
  • Testes unitários
  • Experiencia com ferramentas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Sqs, Sns, Kafka), preferencialmente RabbitMQ
  • Experiencia com sistemas distribuídos, com microserviços que interagem entre si;
  • Experiencia com alguma ferramenta de observabilidade/logs, como DataDog, azuremonitor; CloudWatch
  • Banco de dados não relacional (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experiencia com ambiente de trabalho com estrutura de CI-CD
  • Experiencia com pelo menos 3 ferramentas de Cloud(Exemplo: Aws lambda, Azure functions, SQS, SNS, EC2)
  • Experiencia com docker e kubernetes;
  • Experiencia ou conhecimento do Azure DevOps


Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.
